notes: The three rows of buttons above the email are now one row of menus: which email you're looking at on the left, then View and Send or save. Everything that was there is still there, one click further in, and the menus open over the email instead of pushing it down the pane. The controls took 337px of the pane on a full window and 366px on a half-screen one; they now take 177 either way, so about 165 more pixels of email. Ticking Subject, recipients and checks off in the View menu folds those away too, which leaves 46px of chrome and about 770px of email. What's left to do is gone from the right-hand pane: the job step shows the email instead, updating as you type. The preview still follows the middle pane as you scroll, exactly as before.
